concerns.text: T022c designates the 'test' split as the 'held-out validation set' for SC-003 verification and creates no separate, strictly held-out test set. This violates FR-006 (evaluate on held-out test set) and SC-001 (R² ≥ 0.40 on held-out test set), rendering the primary success criteria unmeasurable without data leakage.

T035a conflates the 'held-out validation set' (used for tuning) with the 'independent test set' required for SC-003 verification. It calculates a threshold from the training set and validates against the tuning set, creating a circular validation that violates the independence required by SC-003 and Constitution Principle VI.

T019 attempts to fetch data from a DOI with an empty value ('DOI ``') and relies on a fallback to a HuggingFace ID. The task fails to define a verified canonical source for the USPTO dataset, violating Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and FR-001 (ingest USPTO dataset).

T007a and T008a (Schema creation) are prerequisites for validation tasks but are marked as unproduced in the 'Repeatedly-unverifiable tasks' section. The task list lacks a recovery step to generate these missing schema files before attempting validation, causing a hard block in the Foundational phase and violating FR-001/FR-006 data hygiene requirements.

T022a includes logic to 'merge classes' if cross-class scaffolds are found. This contradicts Constitution Principle VI (Stratified Chemical Space Evaluation) which mandates stratification by reaction class to ensure independent assessment. Merging classes violates the requirement to measure generalization across distinct chemical spaces.
